instrument: Clean Water Services - City of Sherwood operating intergovernmental agreement (September 22, 2026)
summary: Under the operating IGA, the city is responsible for making projections for population growth and industrial development to support the District's modeling of future regional capacity needs. The District retains regulatory authority and holds the integrated watershed permit; pretreatment permit determinations follow 40 CFR 403.8(f)(2). The agreement runs five years.
notes: Mechanism by which a large industrial load reaches regional wastewater capacity planning: through the city's projections, years before any permit. Sherwood's council approved the agreement unanimously on September 1. Parallel agreements with Banks and Tigard were on the same agenda. Hillsboro is not among the cities updated; its operating IGA has not been obtained.
confidence_note: Read from the board agenda packet, which contains the agreement; the executed instrument has not been separately obtained. Hillsboro's equivalent clause is unknown.
